parser.method: Parse complete -arch all -h -L -l captures only; all per-slice ncmds/indices/cmdsize totals and -L lists reconciled. No target/source decoding.

required_root_premises: Accept exact installed Apple kernel, loader and shared-cache implementation/integrity for the recorded macOS26.5.2/build25F84, including resolution and availability of the17 explicitly listed system-candidate install names. On-disk absence neither proves nor disproves shared-cache availability.

Accept fixed tool implementations, code-signing policy and platform trust store as observation infrastructure; zero codesign status and displayed Apple chain alone do not establish an independent trust anchor.

Accept the stated installed-extension overapproximation as adequate STATIC non-system scope for the retained source operation, separately decide any dynamic-loader/import/environment assumptions and fresh custody.
excluded_claims: Runtime symbol resolution or arbitrary dlopen/plugin closure
Target execution, operational admission or scientific result
root_recommendation: Accept RT02 only as this finite declared-load/non-system identity closure under explicitly accepted Apple-platform and dynamic-boundary premises. If broader hermetic/runtime closure is required, retain RT02 open. RI164 does not choose trust on root's behalf.
